description: "Today, I filed for reelection as State Representative of House District 90. So much has changed in the past four sessions I have served as Representative of HD 90, especially in the past year--the House composition, an unprecedented pandemic, a brutal winter storm, and of course the redrawing of our District map. title: Representative Romero Files For Re-Election For House District 90
